regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the short-term momentum leader, but with shallow breadth (0.118) and mixed trend health. The absolute trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown here (mean-reverting tape), so any trend discipline is experimental. The rotation picture is narrowing and non-directional. Given the track record (hit rate 0.45, directional accuracy 0.35), all leans are expressed with low conviction.
emerging_watch: Observing a potential leadership handoff from AI Compute & Optics to Industrial Metals. Condition to confirm: Industrial Metals (512400.SS) outperforms AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) by at least 2% over a 15-trading-day period and holds a higher momentum rank for 10 consecutive days.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals displays broad, cohesive trend characteristics (Hurst 'trend', high durability_bar 0.69, breadth 0.538) and passed the absolute trend gate. While the gate has no local edge, the theme's internal strength supports an overweight lean within a trend-following architecture. This is a conditional allocation to the continuation of the trend, not a forecast of returns.
theses.dissent: The absolute trend gate historically whipsaws in this market, and mean-reverting dynamics could cause a sharp reversal; the trend may not persist.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS ETF closes below its 50-day simple moving average for 5 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are not eligible under the absolute trend gate and exhibit a 'mean-revert' Hurst tag, indicating no persistent uptrend. A trend-discipline allocation would underweight this theme. The lean reflects a structural avoidance of non-trending sectors in this framework, not a call on absolute downside.
evidence: breadth: high (0.944) but within a mean-reverting regime
theses.dissent: Banks could be lifted by policy support or a rotation out of tech/growth, suddenly igniting an uptrend that the detector would capture late.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS ETF closes above its 50-day simple moving average for 5 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma shows solid trend health (eligible, Hurst 'trend', high durability_bar 0.76, and 85.7% breadth). The crowding flag (z=1.2) is a sizing-caution, not a contraindication; overweight is still appropriate but with a cap on position size. The lean is conditional on the trend staying intact and crowd risk remaining contained.
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a disorderly unwind on any adverse sector-specific news, and the trend gate's historical ineffectiveness here means a trend-following overweight may underperform a simple buy-and-hold.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% over a rolling 10-trading-day window

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
